name: ste-guard
description: Keeps Codex replies in Simplified Technical English. A Stop hook checks each reply and returns the violations so Codex rewrites it.

interface.shortDescription: Simplified Technical English enforcement for Codex replies.
interface.longDescription: Checks every reply against a configurable Simplified Technical English profile. When a rule fails, the Stop hook returns the violations and Codex writes the clean version. Profiles control the word ceiling, the rule switches, and the banned phrase lists.
defaultPrompt: Show me the active STE profile and its word ceiling.
Lint this file against the STE rules.
